quote: Automatic evaluation metrics include the follows: ACC measures how accurately the model transfer the text style. BLEU compares the gold reference and transferred text to measure how well the non-stylistic text tokens are retained after being transferred from the original text . PPL is used to measure the fluency of the transferred text . G-mean is the geometric mean of BLEU and ACC.
